intro f
refine ⟨_, _⟩
· intro g
  intro h
  induction h with a b using WellFoundedLT.wf_induction
  · exact W.rlp.llp.of_rlp (W.rlp.of_coproducts_pushout f g)
  · rcases h with ⟨a, b, h⟩
    haveI : OrderBot J := inferInstance
    haveI : SuccOrder J := inferInstance
    haveI : LinearOrder J := inferInstance
    haveI : WellFoundedLT J := inferInstance
    let c := a + 1
    let d := b + 1
    let e := d + 1
    let f' := CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.coproducts.pushouts.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape J f
    let g' := CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.coproducts.pushouts.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape J g
    let h' := CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.coproducts.pushouts.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape J h
    have h'' : f' ≤ g' := by apply transfiniteCompositionsOfShape.trans
    have h''' : g' ≤ h' := by apply transfiniteCompositionsOfShape.trans
    have h'''' : f' ≤ h' := by apply transfiniteCompositionsOfShape.trans
    exact W.rlp.llp.of_rlp (W.rlp.of_coproducts_pushout f g)
